Real owned commits and native publishing queue rows; silent is false and no full-pipeline stage is skipped to manufacture pass.
Actual database fault injection and native validation failures, with object/transaction/publishing observations; does not prove rollback of arbitrary external effects.
Current fixture's native Herald evaluation/transcripts; arbitrary configured third-party rules/actions are outside this fixed cut and are not certified.

Both native SQL fallback publication and explicitly selected real Gorge HTTP queue profile. Exactly selected owned publishing workers cover native create-with-no-mail and comment-update mail/feed outboxes; delivery workers and external sends are not executed or claimed.
Direct editor integration does not certify every HTTP, Conduit, batch or CLI entry point. Earlier unknown caller/source entries are not reclassified.
Retain independent ordered-policy, default, named-policy, automatic-capability, Space and missing-subject regression fixtures.
Native ORM/filter and source samples use one verified SELECT-only physical connection and actual RR read-only snapshot; A-to-B, fresh B, ABA and membership revocation cases.
Actual native SQL bridge rejects mutations, COMMIT, locks, sleep and outfile; SQL-mode drift blocks and owned reader session is closed.
A stable historical read view is not a future business-write authorization, execution-time lock or revocation freshness guarantee.
Fixed supported rules, bounded native sources and sampled policy configuration do not close arbitrary extensions, organization appointments, every runtime setting or unlimited query resources.
Supported local receipts, exact committed-source hashes, hosted CI/review and merged-main results are distinct gates. No hosted or production result is inferred.
